label: PF Backlog 582
title: Backlog API: POST /backlog/items returns empty resource_id (created id not surfaced)
body: POST /api/v1/backlog/items returns an empty resource_id in the envelope (the created item id is not surfaced), so an API-only creator cannot know the new id without a follow-up list call. Fix: have the endpoint return id/resource_id from the created item (or accept the item id reliably). Found while creating BI-PF-1381.
